name: Hime Choukyou Yugami Kitta Ai no Katachi
original_name: 姫調教歪みきった愛のカタチ
source:
Princess of some country comes to Japan to attract companies to her country. Genius Japanese trader offers his services to introduce the best companies. As a gratitude for help princess has various gifts to offer.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
某国公主来到日本，希望吸引企业前往自己的国家投资。一名天才日本商人主动提出，可以为她引荐最优秀的企业。为了答谢他的帮助，公主也准备了各式各样的“礼物”。

[内容取自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
